lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is irregular, with wider gaps on the posterior flank and tighter clustering towards the mid-torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One visible Y-shaped bifurcation is located on the third vertical stripe from the anterior torso edge, approximately 40% down from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 4th and 5th stripes from the anterior edge exhibit mid-flank termination, failing to reach the ventral hair fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 4-5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch, positioned superior to the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-posterior thigh align horizontally, creating a short geometric line segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate spiral trajectory, extending outward from the skull before curving inward and backward at the distal ends.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.8 times the width of the distance between the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately the top 10% of the total vertical horn structure length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking across the nasal bridge and two distinct white spots on the lower cheek/jaw area.
